name: 走犊坡
Runaway Calf Slope
before: 野地上一头黑牦牛犊子挣断了绳，一路撒欢跑上了坡，后头追着个十岁的放牛娃，鼻涕冻成了冰溜子。坡上一伙盗马贼正在歇脚，伸手就把牛犊套住了，说归他们了。盗马贼里有个最小的，瘦得像根柴，牵着绳子，看看牛犊，又看看娃娃。

A black yak calf has snapped its tether and gone frisking up a slope on the open country, chased by a ten-year-old herd boy whose nose has frozen into icicles. Horse thieves resting on the slope lasso it at once and declare it theirs. The youngest of them, thin as a stick, holds the rope and looks from the calf to the boy and back.
after: 盗马贼被打跑，最小的那个没跑掉，被你们拎了回来，肚子饿得咕咕响。你们给了他一块茶饼，放他走了。放牛娃叫顿珠，抱着牛犊直蹭：「我阿妈叫央金，是认冰的。」他说阿妈六年前领一大队汉人走过东边的冰川，「后来就有人来抓她，要她再领一回」。

The thieves run, but the youngest is too slow and you haul him back, his stomach growling. You give him a tea cake and let him go. The herd boy, Dondrub, hugs his calf. “My mother is Yangchen. She reads the ice.” Six years ago she led a big band of Han men over the eastern glacier, he says, “and now people keep coming to grab her and make her do it again.”

name: 旗杆湾
Flagpole Bay
before: 圣湖边的湖湾里扎着几顶大帐，帐前插着东边草原桑杰头人的旗。顿珠的阿妈央金被绑在旗杆上，几个牦牛骑围着她，逼她带路过东边的冰川：头人想从冰上抄近路，去劫山那边的商道。央金咬着嘴唇，眼睛望着湖，一声不吭。

In a bay of the holy lake stand a few big tents under the banner of Sangye, a chieftain from the eastern grassland. Dondrub's mother Yangchen is tied to the flagpole, yak riders around her, being pressed to guide them over the eastern glacier: the chieftain wants a short cut across the ice to raid the trade road beyond. Yangchen bites her lip, eyes on the lake, and says nothing.
after: 牦牛骑被打散，央金解了下来，一把搂住顿珠。她说六年前领过冰的那队人，二百九十九个，个个脚上绑着铁冰爪，「他们说要去海里。我问海在哪儿，他们说，顺着水走，水总要到海里」。她不肯给头人带路：「那条冰，是给好人走的。」

The riders scatter and Yangchen, untied, sweeps Dondrub into her arms. The band she led over six years ago, she says, was two hundred and ninety-nine strong, every one in iron crampons. “They said they were going to the sea. I asked where the sea was. They said: follow the water; water always gets to the sea.” She refused the chieftain. “That ice is for good people to walk.”

name: 冬窝子
The Winter Fold
before: 野地上一片冬窝子，几户牧人夏天割下的草一垛垛码在石圈里，留着雪大时喂牛。桑杰头人的后队把这里占了，拿牧人的草喂自己的马，一垛一垛地拆，眼看着撑不到开春。牧人们赶着瘦牛在圈外转，进不去。

On the open country is a winter fold where a few herding families stack the hay they cut in summer inside stone rings, kept for when the snow lies deep. Chieftain Sangye's rearguard has seized it and is feeding the herders' hay to its own horses, stack by stack; at this rate it won't last to spring. The herders circle outside with their thin cattle, unable to get in.
after: 后队被赶走，草垛重新码好，还剩大半。央金说这片冬窝子是那年汉人们帮着扩的：他们在这里歇过一夜，临走把石圈加高了三尺，「说草别让雪埋了」。

The rearguard is driven off and the hay restacked; more than half is left. The Han men enlarged this fold, Yangchen says: they rested here a night and, before leaving, raised the stone rings three feet. “So the snow wouldn't bury the hay, they said.”
first: 后队留下的：两车豆料、一顶好帐篷、十几副马蹄铁、一坛青稞酒，还有一张头人画的冰川图，画得全不对，央金看了直笑，拿去给顿珠垫了靴子。

What the rearguard left: two carts of bean fodder, a good tent, a dozen sets of horseshoes, a jar of barley wine, and the chieftain's own map of the glacier, so wrong that Yangchen laughed and used it to line Dondrub's boots.
pass: 每次路过，冬窝子的牧人都从草垛里掏出一包东西塞给你们：风干的牦牛肉，还有一小罐酸奶，「在草里捂着，冻不硬」。
Every time you pass, the herders pull a bundle out of a haystack for you: dried yak meat and a little crock of yoghurt. “Kept in the hay, it doesn't freeze.”

name: 名石滩
Name-Stone Beach
before: 圣湖东岸一片湖滩，滩上摆着一圈扁石头，块块有茶砖那么大，每块刻着一个汉名，面朝东。几个雪山弓手替头人修营房，正把石头一块块撬起来装上牛车。央金冲上去拦，被一个弓手推倒在湖边。

On the holy lake's eastern shore lies a ring of flat stones, each the size of a tea brick, each carved with a Han name and turned to face east. Some snow-mountain archers building quarters for the chieftain are prising them up and loading them on ox carts. Yangchen rushes to stop them and an archer shoves her down at the water's edge.
after: 弓手被打跑，石头一块块摆回原处，二百九十九块，一块不少。央金说这是他们走前一夜摆的，「对着湖说了一夜的话」。最东边那块没刻名字，只刻了一个箭头，箭头前面一个字：「海」。

The archers are chased away and the stones set back one by one, all two hundred and ninety-nine. They laid these the night before they left, Yangchen says, “and talked to the lake all night.” The easternmost stone bears no name, only an arrow, and in front of the arrow a single character: 'Sea'.

name: 靴毡帐
The Boot-Felt Tent
before: 野地上一顶小帐篷，帐里一个老阿妈戴着顶针，正缝一双毡靴里子，身边摞着的毡片比她人还高。头人的几个骑兵闯进来，要她三天内缝一百双，给头人的兵过冰川用，缝不完就烧帐篷。老阿妈说她只缝一种靴子，一年只缝一双。

In a little tent on the open country an old woman in a thimble is stitching felt boot liners, a pile of felt beside her taller than she is. Some of the chieftain's cavalry burst in demanding a hundred pairs in three days for his men to cross the glacier, or they'll burn the tent. She says she sews only one kind of boot, and only one pair a year.
after: 骑兵被赶走了。老阿妈说六年前她给那队汉人缝过靴里子，缝了一个冬天，手指头全是针眼。可汉人们要的是三百双：「还有一个，没到。」第三百双她一直留着，每年拆了重缝一回，怕毡子朽了。她把那双靴里子包好，塞给你们：「见着那一个，替我给他。」

The cavalry are driven out. Six years ago, she says, she sewed liners for those Han men all one winter, until her fingers were full of needle pricks. But they ordered three hundred pairs: “There's one more, not here yet.” She has kept the three hundredth pair ever since, unpicking and resewing it every year so the felt won't rot. She wraps it and presses it on you. “When you meet that one, give it to him from me.”

name: 黑冰河
Black Ice River
before: 野地上一条封冻的河，头人的步卒在冰面上设了卡，谁从冰上过河都要交一只羊。央金领你们走到河边，却不走他们的冰面，指着冰上一片发黑发亮的地方：「那儿薄。」头人的人不信，嘲笑她胆小，还在那片黑冰上排着队，拔刀拦住你们。

A frozen river crosses the open country, and the chieftain's foot soldiers have set a checkpoint on it: one sheep from anyone crossing the ice. Yangchen leads you to the bank but won't use their crossing; she points to a dark, glossy patch. “That's thin.” The soldiers laugh at her for a coward, line up right on the black ice and draw on you.
after: 一交手，那片黑冰咔嚓塌了，一排人掉进齐腰的冰水里，被你们一个个拽上来，冻得说不出话。央金说是她爹教的：冰透着黑，是薄得能看见底下的水；又白又浑的，才是厚冰。那年她就这么领着二百九十九个人，一个不少过了这条河。

As the fighting starts, the black ice cracks and gives way, dropping a whole row into waist-deep water; you haul them out one by one, too cold to speak. Her father taught her, Yangchen says: ice that looks black is so thin you're seeing the water through it; thick ice is white and cloudy. That's how she brought all two hundred and ninety-nine across this river without losing one.

name: 头人营
The Chieftain's Camp
before: 野地上扎着桑杰头人的大营，刀手、弓手、骑手三路，营里立着一面大旗，旗上画着冰川和一条往东的箭头。头人在营里练兵，没了向导，就要靠自己硬闯冰川。营门口堆着几十副临时打的冰爪，铁齿歪歪扭扭。

Chieftain Sangye's main camp sprawls over the open country, swordsmen, archers and riders in three wings, a great banner showing a glacier and an arrow pointing east. Without a guide, he is drilling his men to force the ice on their own. At the gate lie dozens of hastily forged crampons, their spikes all crooked.
after: 大营被冲散，头人骑马往冰川那边逃了。央金拎起一副冰爪看了看就扔了：「这种齿，踩上去就打滑。」她说那队汉人的冰爪是自己打的，齿斜着打，「他们说，过冰跟过崖一样，钉子要往里斜」。

The camp is broken and the chieftain flees on horseback towards the glacier. Yangchen picks up one of the crampons, looks it over and tosses it away. “Spikes like that, you'll slide.” The Han men forged their own, she says, the spikes set at a slant. “They said crossing ice is like crossing a cliff: the nail has to angle inward.”

name: 冰舌口
The Ice Tongue
before: 冰川的冰舌一直伸进湖里，冰崖蓝得发黑，冰脚下的湖滩上时不时冒出些从冰里化出来的东西：一只皮靴，一截绳子，一块骨头。一伙捡宝的山民雇了几个弓手守着冰脚，捡到什么都拿去卖。今天他们捡到一只铜铃，正为它吵架。

The glacier's tongue runs right into the lake, its ice cliff blue going on black, and the beach at its foot keeps turning up things melted out of the ice: a leather boot, a length of rope, a bone. A gang of scavengers has hired archers to hold the ice foot and sells whatever they find. Today they've found a bronze bell and are quarrelling over it.
after: 铜铃抢了回来，铃舌上缠着红线，是千里号骡队的驮铃。央金说冰川是在走的，走得极慢，一年往下挪一截，掉进冰缝的东西，过几年总会从冰舌底下吐出来。「那年过冰缝，掉下去一头骡子，人一个没掉。」她把铃擦干净：「它走了六年，才走到这儿。」

You win the bell back: red thread wound round its clapper: a Qianli mule bell. A glacier moves, Yangchen says, very slowly, creeping down a little every year, and whatever falls into a crevasse comes out from under the tongue sooner or later. “A mule fell in a crevasse that year. Not a single person did.” She polishes the bell. “It took six years to walk this far.”

name: 冰梯谷
Ladder Valley
before: 野地尽头一条窄谷，谷里横着一道道冰裂缝，每道缝上搭着一架木梯，梯脚拿铁钉钉进冰里：这就是过冰川的冰梯。桑杰头人手下最精的人马把守在谷口，刀、弓、马三层，冰梯全被抽了上来，码在他们身后烤火，已经烧了两架。

At the end of the open country is a narrow valley crossed by crevasse after crevasse, each bridged by a wooden ladder spiked into the ice: the ladders for crossing the glacier. Chieftain Sangye's best troops hold the valley mouth, three ranks of blades, bows and horses, and they have pulled up every ladder and stacked them behind them for firewood. Two are already burnt.
after: 头人的精兵被打散，没烧的冰梯一架架搬回原处。梯子是六年前那队汉人做的，横档上刻着字：「一档一人，过一个，喊一声。」央金说那天过梯，她听他们喊了二百九十九声，一声不少。

The chieftain's elite are routed and the unburnt ladders laid back in place. The Han men built them six years ago, and the rungs are carved: 'One rung, one man. Each one across, call out.' That day, Yangchen says, she heard them call two hundred and ninety-nine times, not one missing.

name: 雪线坡
Snow-Line Slope
before: 湖边往东的山坡上，一道白线拦腰划过：线以上的雪一年四季不化，线以下是草。几个头人派来的探子正顺着雪线插小旗，给后面的大队标路，旗全插在背阴的那一面。央金说他们要把人往死路上领，探子拔刀不许她拔旗。

On the slopes east of the lake a white line cuts across the mountainside: above it the snow never melts all year, below it is grass. Some of the chieftain's scouts are planting little flags along the snow line to mark a way for the main body, every one on the shady side. Yangchen says they'll lead men to their deaths, and the scouts draw blades to stop her pulling the flags.
after: 探子被打跑，小旗全拔了。央金指给你们看：同一座山，向阳那面的雪线高，背阴那面的低，「往东走，要走向阳坡，雪浅，少走一天冰」。向阳坡的雪线底下，每隔一段就有一个小石堆，是那队汉人留的路标，石堆顶上压着一片茶叶，早成了渣。

The scouts are chased off and the flags pulled. Yangchen shows you: on the same mountain the snow line sits higher on the sunny face and lower on the shady one. “Going east, keep to the sunny slope. Shallower snow, a day less on the ice.” Just below the snow line on the sunny side, every so often, stands a little cairn the Han men left as a waymark, a tea leaf crumbled to dust on top of each.

name: 冰墙营
The Ice-Wall Camp
before: 野地上，东边冰川垭口前的最后一片平地，桑杰头人收拢了剩下的人马，牦牛骑、刀手、弓手扎下一座大营，营前拿冰块垒了一道墙。头人站在墙上喊：「这条冰，我过不去，你们也别想过！」

On the last flat ground before the eastern glacier pass, Chieftain Sangye has gathered what remains of his force, yak riders, swordsmen and archers, into a great camp walled in front with blocks of ice. He shouts from the top of the wall: “If I can't cross this ice, neither can you!”
after: 冰墙被推倒，头人被拖下了墙，嘴里还在嘟囔。他其实过过一回冰：六年前偷偷跟在那队汉人后头，走到一半怕了，回来了。「他们回头喊我，」他红着脸说，「喊『跟上』。我没敢跟。」

The ice wall comes down and the chieftain is dragged off it, still muttering. He has been on the ice once before: six years ago he trailed the Han men in secret and turned back halfway, frightened. “They looked back and called to me,” he says, red in the face. “'Keep up,' they called. I didn't dare.”

name: 放生口
Mercy Gap
before: 野地上一道窄口，是下冰川前最后的路，一伙盗马贼守在这里，领头的是个独眼汉子，绰号独角达瓦，北边最凶的盗马贼头子之一。他听说有人要过冰，叫手下把弓都拉开了。他身后站着个瘦得像根柴的孩子，正扯他的袖子。

A narrow gap on the open country is the last way before the glacier, held by horse thieves under a one-eyed man called One-Horn Dawa, among the fiercest thief chiefs of the north. Hearing someone means to cross the ice, he has his men draw their bows. Behind him a child, thin as a stick, is tugging at his sleeve.
after: 盗马贼被打退，达瓦没再追。那孩子是他儿子小扎巴，就是走犊坡上被你们塞了块茶饼放走的那个。「我儿子说，你们给他吃的，没打他。」达瓦让开了路，又说那年过冰的汉人也在这口子上分过他一块茶，「那时候我差点饿死，后来才有了这个儿子」。

The thieves are beaten back and Dawa doesn't follow. The child is his son, little Drakpa, the boy you sent off from Runaway Calf Slope with a tea cake. “My son says you fed him and didn't beat him.” Dawa stands aside, and adds that the Han men who crossed the ice once shared a brick of tea with him at this very gap. “I was half starved then. This son came after.”

name: 末营墙
The Last Camp Wall
before: 野地上一座塌了半边的石屋，是冰川下面最后一个能避风的地方，屋里的墙上写满了炭字。一伙路过的猎户在屋里剥狐皮，拿墙皮磨刀，刮掉了一大片。央金冲进去，一把夺过刀：「这墙上的字，比你们的命还金贵。」猎户们抄起了弓。

A half-collapsed stone hut on the open country is the last shelter below the glacier, its walls covered in charcoal writing. Passing hunters are skinning foxes inside and honing knives on the plaster, scraping off a whole patch. Yangchen storms in and snatches a knife away. “Those words are worth more than your lives.” The hunters reach for their bows.
after: 猎户被赶走，刮掉的那片补不回来了，剩下的还看得清，是那队人最后一夜写的：「第四年春，东去，顺水到海，赴三路之约。」底下一行小字：「镖头若来，告之：名单那一半，我们带着；他那一半，请后来的人带来。」

The hunters are run off. The scraped patch is lost, but the rest can still be read, written on their last night: 'Fourth spring. Going east, down the water to the sea, to keep the three roads' appointment.' And beneath, smaller: 'If the chief comes, tell him: we carry our half of the list. His half, let those who come after bring it.'

name: 雪人窟
Yeti Caves
before: 湖边的冰崖下有几个黑洞洞的窟窿，牧人们说里头住着雪人，一人多高，能站着走，一掌能拍死一头牦牛。今年开春雪人又出来了，扒了好几家的羊圈，还在雪上留下一串比脸盆还大的脚印。牧人们请你们去看看。

Under an ice cliff by the lake gape several black holes, and the herders say yetis live there, taller than a man, walking upright, able to kill a yak with one blow. This spring they came out again, tore open several sheepfolds and left a line of footprints in the snow bigger than washbasins. The herders ask you to go and look.
after: 洞里冲出来的是三头藏棕熊，被你们赶上了冰川。央金说雪人她也找过一辈子，找着的从来都是熊：站起来一人多高，脚印在雪里化一化，就比脸盆还大。冰崖下的洞冬暖夏凉，熊年年来这里冬眠，开春饿着肚子出来，赶走一窝，明年又来一窝，只能年年来清。

What charges out of the caves is three Tibetan brown bears, which you drive up onto the glacier. Yangchen has hunted yetis all her life, she says, and always found bears: upright they stand taller than a man, and once a print melts a little in the snow it's bigger than a basin. The caves stay mild all winter, so bears come back to sleep in them every year and wake hungry in spring; drive one family off and another moves in, so it has to be cleared every year.

name: 画师帐
The Painter's Tent
before: 野地上一顶白帐篷，帐里挂着一幅没画完的唐卡，三尺宽，画着一条大冰川，冰上一串小人往东走。画师诺布是个年轻姑娘，正举着画笔挡在唐卡前：桑杰头人的几个骑兵闯进来，要把唐卡拿去给头人当路图。他们已经抢走了她的颜料箱。

In a white tent on the open country hangs an unfinished thangka three feet wide: a great glacier, and a string of tiny figures walking east across it. The painter, a young woman named Norbu, stands in front of it brandishing her brush. Some of Chieftain Sangye's cavalry have burst in to take the painting as a route map for him, and they've already carried off her box of pigments.
after: 骑兵被打跑，唐卡保住了，颜料箱却被他们带走了。诺布说这幅画是六年前那队汉人请她画的，拿最后一块茶付的定钱，说要画「我们走的路，给后来的人看」。还差两样颜色：画湖的青金石，画路的金粉，都在颜料箱里。

The cavalry are driven off and the thangka saved, but the pigment box is gone. Those Han men commissioned this painting six years ago, Norbu says, paying the deposit with their last brick of tea: “Paint the road we took, for whoever comes after.” Two colours are still missing, lapis for the lake and gold for the road, and both were in the box.

name: 数钟道
Bell-Counting Road
before: 往神庙去的大路上，桑杰头人的最后一伙弓手躲在玛尼石墙后头放冷箭，他们听说神庙里供着汉人留下的宝，想抢一把再走。天快黑了，央金催着赶路：「赶得上的话，能听见钟。」

On the main road to the temple, the chieftain's last few archers are sniping from behind a wall of mani stones; they've heard the temple keeps treasure the Han men left and want a share before they go. Dusk is coming, and Yangchen hurries you on. “If we're quick, we'll hear the bell.”
after: 弓手被赶跑。正好日头落山，神庙的钟响了，一下，一下，你们数到二百九十九，停了。央金说那队人走后，护法们每天傍晚敲一回，一个人一下：「敲着，就是说他们还在路上。」

The archers are chased away. Just as the sun goes down the temple bell begins, one stroke, then another; you count to two hundred and ninety-nine and it stops. Since that band left, Yangchen says, the guardians have rung it every dusk, one stroke per man. “As long as it's rung, it means they're still on the road.”

name: 法螺岗
Conch Ridge
before: 野地上一道土岗，一伙盗马贼刚从神庙里偷出一只白海螺，是庙里早晚吹的法螺，正拿它当酒碗，一边喝一边往外吹，吹得像牛叫。庙里的小喇嘛追到岗下，被他们的刀逼了回去。

On a ridge of the open country, horse thieves have stolen a white conch from the temple, the trumpet blown there morning and evening, and are drinking out of it and blowing it between swigs, honking like a cow. The little lamas chasing them to the foot of the ridge have been driven back by their blades.
after: 盗马贼被打跑，法螺还了回去。小喇嘛擦着螺说，这只螺是从几千里外的海边换来的，传了好几代。那队汉人听了，每回听见它吹，都要停下手里的活：「这东西从海里来，我们就往海里去。」

The thieves are chased off and the conch returned. Polishing it, a little lama says it was traded up from a seashore thousands of miles away and has been passed down for generations. When the Han men heard that, they stopped work every time it sounded. “This came from the sea. So the sea is where we'll go.”

name: 海石坡
Sea-Stone Slope
before: 神庙下面的野地坡上，一伙石贩子雇了几个雪山弓手，拿锤子从岩层里敲「龙鳞石」，一块卖一只羊，说揣着能避雪崩。石头上一圈圈盘着纹，像蜗牛壳，又像卷起来的鞭子。央金说那队汉人走前，也在这片坡上敲过石头，弓手们就拿箭对着她。

On the slope below the temple, stone sellers with hired snow-mountain archers are hammering 'dragon-scale stones' out of the rock to sell for a sheep apiece, as charms against avalanches. Each stone is coiled with a spiral like a snail shell or a rolled-up whip. The Han men chipped stones on this slope too before they left, Yangchen says, and the archers turn their arrows on her.
after: 弓手被赶走。你们队里识货的人认出来：这是菊石，海里的东西，很久很久以前，这座雪山还是海底，后来被一点点挤上了天。央金说那队人里也有人认得，他们一人揣了一块：「从海里来的，带回海里去。」山神就在坡顶的庙里，等着你们。

The archers are driven off. Someone in your company knows what these are: ammonites, sea creatures. Very long ago this snow mountain was the floor of a sea, and was slowly pushed up into the sky. One of the Han men knew too, Yangchen says, and each of them pocketed one. “It came from the sea; we'll take it back to the sea.” The Mountain God waits in the temple at the top of the slope.

name: 抢色营
The Pigment Raiders' Camp
before: 野地上，抢走颜料箱的骑兵跑回了头人的辎重营，营里刀手、弓手、骑手三路守着。他们把青金石当成了宝石，正拿刀撬，要一块块拿去山下卖；金粉撒了一地，被当成沙子扫进了雪里。诺布趴在营外的雪坡上，急得直咬袖子。

On the open country the cavalry who stole the pigment box have fled back to the chieftain's baggage camp, guarded by swordsmen, archers and riders. They take the lapis for gemstones and are prising it apart with knives to sell piece by piece; the gold powder has spilled and been swept into the snow as dirt. Norbu lies on the snowy slope outside, chewing her sleeve in anguish.
after: 辎重营被打散，颜料箱抢了回来，青金石一块没少，金粉从雪里一点点筛回来，只剩小半包。诺布捧着箱子说，小半包也够了：画路，只要一道细线。

The baggage camp is broken and the box recovered, the lapis all there; the gold you sift back out of the snow grain by grain, and only a small half-packet remains. Norbu cradles the box. Half a packet is enough, she says. For a road, you only need a fine line.

name: 东垭口
The East Pass
before: 野地尽头，冰川最高处的东垭口，再往东就是下山的路。桑杰头人逃到这里，拿最后的家底雇了最狠的一帮人，刀、弓、马守着垭口，要收过冰的人一道「垭口税」，十年、二十年地收下去。垭口上的风刮得人站不住，一块石碑被他们推倒在雪里。

At the far end of the open country is the East Pass at the glacier's crest; beyond it the road goes down. Chieftain Sangye has fled here and spent the last of his fortune on the hardest crew he could hire, blades, bows and horses holding the pass, meaning to tax everyone who crosses the ice for ten years, twenty. The wind up here won't let you stand, and they've pushed a stone marker over into the snow.
after: 守垭口的人被打散，头人背着冰爪下山去了。你们把石碑扶起来，碑上刻着：「千里号茶队二百九十九人，过此。后来者，跟上。」往东望去，冰化成溪，溪汇成河，河一路向东，消失在云底下。央金说，河的尽头就是海，海的中间，三条路汇到一处。

The pass guards are routed and the chieftain trudges back down with his crampons on his back. You raise the marker. It reads: 'Two hundred and ninety-nine of the Qianli tea train passed here. You who come after, keep up.' Looking east, the ice melts into streams, the streams join into a river, and the river runs on eastward until it vanishes beneath the clouds. At the river's end is the sea, Yangchen says, and in the middle of the sea, three roads meet.

name: 唐卡铺
The Thangka Shop
before: 野地尽头一间石头小铺，是诺布的画坊，墙上挂满了唐卡，门口卖颜料、经幡、木雕。诺布回来那天，铺子已经叫一伙收债的打手占了：头人逃走前把铺子抵了自己的债。诺布要在铺子里画完那幅唐卡，打手们说铺子不还，画也别想画。

At the end of the open country stands a little stone shop, Norbu's studio, its walls hung with thangkas and its doorway selling pigments, prayer flags and carvings. When Norbu gets back, debt collectors have occupied it: the chieftain pledged her shop against his own debts before he fled. She means to finish the painting here, and the toughs say no shop, no painting.
after: 打手被打跑，铺子重新开张，诺布拿颜料、唐卡、经幡换你们车上的货，价钱公道。她关起门画了三天，唐卡画完了：青金石的圣湖，湖水往东流成一条河，一直流进海里；金粉的一道细线，从冰川上二百九十九个小人脚下画起，画到海中间一座岛，岛上三条路汇在一处。雪山上站着一个人，背着匣子，望着他们的背影。「他们说，」诺布说，「这一个，要画成还在路上的样子。」

The toughs are chased out and the shop reopens: pigments, thangkas and prayer flags for the goods on your carts, at fair prices. Norbu shuts herself in for three days and the thangka is finished. The lapis lake flows east into a river and on into the sea; a fine gold line starts at the feet of two hundred and ninety-nine tiny figures on the glacier and runs to an island in the middle of the sea where three roads meet. On the snow mountain stands one man with a casket on his back, watching them go. “They said,” Norbu tells you, “this one should be painted still on the road.”

name: 山神殿
The Mountain God's Hall
before: 雪山神庙的大殿前，二百九十九面经幡在风里一齐响，每面写着一个名字。殿前那张空了十年的石座，今天坐着山神：绛红大氅，背上一只铁匣，脸上一张桦木面具，黑脸，浓眉，眼角一道疤，哈气从眼孔里一缕缕冒出来。护法僧兵、雪山弓手、牦牛骑在阶下排开，聂驿丞提灯站在一旁。山神开口，是陆九的声音：「冬不过山。东边那道冰，打得过我，才走得过。」

Before the temple's great hall, two hundred and ninety-nine prayer flags crack together in the wind, a name on each. The stone seat empty for ten years has someone on it today: the Mountain God, in a crimson cloak, an iron casket on his back, a birch mask on his face, dark, heavy-browed, a scar by one eye, breath streaming from the eyeholes. Guardian monks, snow-mountain archers and yak riders line the steps below; Stationmaster Nie stands to one side with his lamp. The Mountain God speaks, and the voice is Lu Jiu's: “No crossing in winter. Beat me, and you can walk the eastern ice.”
after:
山神摘下面具，底下是同一张脸。陆九把面具翻过来，背面是二百九十九人一人一刀刻的字：「护住这条路，等后来的人。」冬封碑上那两个字，原来是这样接下去的。他嚼了贡布的茶，穿上第三百双靴里子：「雾驿主数少的那一个，是我。」

他们六年前就往东去了，带着那半张名单。陆九把匣里的半张名单、半块茶砖交到你们手里，第三道锁仍扣着：「到了三条路汇合的地方，自有人开。」他重新戴上面具：「我守着这条路。守到后来的人都过去了，我也上路。」

The Mountain God lifts off his mask, and beneath it is the same face. Lu Jiu turns the mask over: on the back, each of the two hundred and ninety-nine carved one stroke of a line: 'Guard this road, and wait for those who come after.' So that is how the two words on the winter stone go on. He chews Gonpo's tea and pulls on the three hundredth pair of boot liners. “The one the Fog Master counted missing, that was me.”

They went east six years ago, taking their half of the list. Lu Jiu puts the casket's half list and his half tea brick into your hands, the third lock still shut. “Where the three roads meet, someone will open it.” He puts the mask back on. “I'll guard this road. When everyone who comes after has gone through, I'll take the road too.”
